sources.title: PDF NVIDIA-Nemotron-3-Nano-4B-GGUF - NVIDIA Developer
sources.snippet: NVIDIA-Nemotron-3-Nano-4B is an edge-ready small language model intended for Agentic AI in edge platforms (Jetson Thor, GeForce RTX, DGX Spark). It targets key-uses including AI gaming NPCs (teammates / companions), local voice assistants (for devices, apps, and games), and IoT automation.

sources.snippet: Model Overview NVIDIA-Nemotron-3-Nano-4B-GGUF is quantized version (Q4_K_M) of NVIDIA-Nemotron-3-Nano-4B-BF16 and is a small language model (SLM) trained from scratch by NVIDIA, and designed as a unified model for both reasoning and non-reasoning tasks.
